title: TNFR-Python-Engine: Resonant Fractal Nature Theory Implementation
description:
TNFR-Python-Engine is a Python framework for coherent-pattern analysis on graph-coupled networks. The nodal relation dEPI/dt = nu_f DeltaNFR organizes a declared evolution model; pressure, phase, capacity, support and any additional forcing require their own specifications.

The engine provides 13 registered structural operators, grammar U1-U6, shared integration and the structural-field tetrad: potential, phase-gradient magnitude, circular phase curvature and coherence length. These fields are diagnostics; they do not reconstruct every nodal state or independently select its evolution. Operator contracts distinguish primary effects, auxiliary writes, grammar admission and execution provenance.

Version 0.0.3.6 integrates scoped diffusion, memory, phase/form and quotient research with corrected documentation. Exact identities, conditional theorems, represented finite observations, auxiliary wave/Hamiltonian/arithmetic models and open hypotheses are identified separately. Passing tests is not proof of unrestricted stability, autonomous physical emergence or a Millennium conjecture. The research execution plan remains the single source of current priorities.

The release also consolidates technical guides, preserves the Spanish educational manuscript as a draft, archives obsolete material and validates documentation against implemented contracts. See the 0.0.3.6 release, versioned source, Python package and current documentation.
